notes.title: Update 0.0.1.1 Arrived !
notes.notes:
Hello Mobsters!

UPDATE 0.0.1.1 finally arrived, I know we had promised until last year but we had several problems, including the Family Bussines project corrupted and we had to rush to solve this problem and to improve even more. Don became seriously ill in the last few months, but everything It's in perfect harmony now!


What's new in this update?

Well, we finally had the addition of two new gamemodes: KILL CONFIRMED AND FREE FOR ALL, available for all maps!

As we also had the addition of a new map on Voodoo Business: Route 666!


Improvements and fixes


Fixed the issue of the warning menu not leaving the screen when played

Fixed the issue of unstable servers

Translation corrections

Zombies hanging around some corners

Fix Bots stuck in doors

Improvement in widgets and fluidity of information on the screen

Weapon balancing



Where are the other additions?


We had a lot of losses due to the corruption of the Family Business, so many things had to be removed, such as the map of the Smuggling Factory, which whether or not it interfered a lot with our production as it took months of work for something that had to be discarded. Family Business is stable in this update, but the project itself is unstable!

What will be done to correct the instability?


It's finally where we wanted it to be, Famiy Business will be REMAKE FROM SCRATCH, that's exactly what you read! We are going to redo it from scratch, so it may take a few months or years for the next update to come out, but don't be sad because it will be our cue to leave ALPHA and enter BETA! I'm sorry that this may be discouraging for some to have to wait longer for more content but it is because we will have the guarantee that the project will be stable and that means more frequent updates such as new mechanics and severe gameplay changes among them:


Weapons will have procedural recoil and more complete and complex animations

There will be different versions, you will have the freedom to jump, climb, throw grenades, etc

System of climbing stairs and parkour on objects

Perks in voodoo business were present as well as final on each map


MANY THINGS ARE ALREADY BEING PRODUCED AND WE GUARANTEE FAMILY BUSINESS WILL NOT STOP!

FINAL CONSIDERATIONS

Our studio apologizes for the delay, we want to hope that 2025 will be a wonderful year for all of you! We are at full steam working on a new horror project to finance more Family Business costs as well as informing you about the progress of the project! If you want to make a donation and help this new phase of Family Business, feel welcome to do so, just get in touch by email: Contato.FamilyBusiness@gmail.com

We want to thank everyone for their loyalty throughout this time! If you have any questions or problems, don't hesitate to let us know!

We'll see you again soon!

Enjoy!

-Don

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312675/811ea767bc624b40ef3797fd0f799e9e93e79d31.png

notes.title: Update Coming !
notes.notes:
Hello Mobsters!

I have great news for you! You asked for more content so here it goes:

What will we get in the 0.0.1.1 update?

In addition to several bug fixes and optimizations, we will be adding 2 NEW MAPS :

Smuggling Factory - Getting weapons has never been so easy! Of course they are fake but what can you expect from mobsters, right?

Route 666 - We are on a new route, a route towards hell! It's better to arm yourself because the bewitched are eager to have dinner!

In addition to these two maps, we will also have 2 NEW GAMEMODES :

Kill Confirmed - Kill your opponents and collect your dog tag to score!

Free For All - Nobody knows who the impostor is, so when in doubt, shoot everyone!

We will also have new gunplay mechanics! Since we are still producing the animations, at least this procedural shooting mechanic should help immerse you in the game!

Will we have more updates this year?

I'm sorry to say no, we will just have patches to fix any issues that appear. But I guarantee that we will still have great news to share with you! However, it is still a secret document!

We have a lot of things in mind to do! Our focus now is to release this update as quickly as possible and then prepare the next one, which may be the biggest update in Family Business history! It will be a new phase, a new world, a new universe!

So now just wait! I thank everyone for their loyalty and patience!

- Don

notes.title: Update 0.0.1.0
notes.notes:
Hello Mobsters !

As I said, here is the update 0.0.1.0 !

As everyone is already tired of knowing, I work alone on this project, so it turns out that failures and errors can often occur in the version that comes to you, I wanted to apologize for the old version 0.0.0.9 which was more unstable than a bomb! But I believe this version has fixed most of the problems. So that you can understand the size of the problem:

Voodoo Business Multiplayer was made in just 3 months, I know it seems impossible but I did it, but of course in 3 months of work it is obvious that we will have 3 months of problems too, mainly problems with servers...

HOWEVER...Version 0.0.1.0 has arrived to save the day !

As usual, here is the list of fixes and changes made in this update (This is a big list for me) :


Update list 0.0.1.0 :


 Version from Unreal Engine 4.26 to Unreal Engine 4.27

 New HUD

 New icons

 New unique songs

 New post processing

 Added weapon research system in the store

 Fixed bug not spawning in Family Business

 Fixed bug where buying weapons animations for the server are not working

 Fixed bug where settings reset all player progress

 Grenade sounds changed

 Grenades have their sound affected by the settings

 New Effects for Grenades

 Added weapon boost (Only in Voodoo Business for now)

 Ragdolls improvement

 Fixed issue with ammo being reset after reloading (If it persists, please report!)

 Headshots have a special sound (For now a mechanic from Voodoo Business)

 Crouch icon removed (Useless)

 HUD animation after changing shooting type

 German Lollipop now explodes instantly when touching anything

 Code optimization

 Correction of incorrect translations

 Fix for players not respawning

 Fixed issue with kill feed showing the wrong weapon

 Fixed bug where step particles spawn in everyone

 Shot collisions issue fixed

 Improved the kill feed that now shows different types of deaths

 Adding more weapons to bots

 Fixed infinite barriers glitch

 Fixed issue with bots not opening doors

 New loading system for maps

 Fixed songs ending and not playing anymore

 New songs in gamemodes

 Sun size decreased

 New weapon added (Cannoli)

 Fixed Voodoo Offering disappearing right after spawning

 Fixed the problem with names not appearing after two powers obtained in Voodoo Business

 Fixed server issues in Voodoo Business

 Improved game ending system in Voodoo Business, no longer requiring everyone to be dead, just knocked down

 Fixed issue with HUD not disappearing for the Client in Voodoo Business when the match ends

 Fixed the issue with the nuclear siren stop button only working for the Server

 Reduced spawn time

 Fixed issue with life not being restored in Family Business

 Improved low health heartbeat system

 New designs in the Main Menu

 New ammo tables for both teams

 Changes of various textures across maps, for example the barriers from Voodoo Business

 Readjusted doors


There were a lot of things fixed but still, there must definitely be some other bugs out there...Anyway, here's a photo of the new weapon and the new ammo stocks :

Cannoli the newest weapon of Family Business!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312675/7e841a877d08acfa8222528c88508363b590e664.png

A classic revolver ! Good for killing a drug lord and a corrupt cop in a restaurant! This little revolver is so portable and easy to use that you can even hide it in the bathroom! With 5 bullets for 5 different problems and rapid fire, it's only a matter of time before your problems disappear !

You can now purchase Cannoli from the smuggler for as little as: [spoiler]$8000[/spoiler]

New ammunition stocks!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312675/c19406bd43f3d3674f40eb2741d9998e5eb08a4d.png

This is the new police ammunition stock, more organized, cleaner, more similar to what the law actually requires !

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312675/cd7ee7f9def9c4f5107bf9e334b9b0a253b12904.png

This is the mob's new ammunition stash, messier, dirtier, more like what the law would prohibit !

Final Notes :

After this update it should be easier to update Family Business, many things have been improved and that make my work easier, one of the best things was definitely changing the graphics engine version!

New release of Unreal Engine 4, what will this change ?

Simply everything opens a new window of opportunities for new codes and mechanics, not to mention new plugins to be used. This version is more stable and less "bugged", meaning that problems that were common, such as server problems not appearing, are now resolved

What will be the next update ?

Well, the next update will probably be correction, balancing and maybe it could include some new map for both game modes. As a result, this update was a watershed for Family Business, as it is more stable and makes it easier and more comfortable to launch new content such as maps and different game modes

When will we have animations for weapons ?

I will be starting to develop the animations in the coming months, they will not necessarily be applied to the game, as quality is something we value a lot, so as many things are without animations we are in no rush to deliver something of good quality

When will we receive new content for Voodoo Business ?

Soon there will be lots of new things from drinks, cigars, easter eggs, missions and bosses! But to do this, you must first build a good foundation of gameplay stability to prevent new mechanics from conflicting

Well mafiosos I think that's it ! My mission has been accomplished once again and I will see you soon! Feel free to ask anything or even send your ideas !

Enjoy !

-Don

notes.title: Family Business Patch
notes.notes:
Hello mobsters !

Well, I apologize for what happened, it was a problem in the " Save " and " Load " codes for Player Information and Loadouts files. For those who are not familiar, there are 6 files created in total :

1 Player Information file

5 Player Loadouts files

What happened was that when I did the 0.0.0.8 update, absolutely everything was redone in codes and when I exported the project to you Old Saves were still stored on Steam, so I simply added an update verification system to delete all Old Saves as well I added this functionality when you decide to Reset progress.

If your game is persisting with the problem of HUD elements not appearing correctly or even mechanics that are broken, contact us immediately so that we can find the solution to your problem and thus allowing a better experience with Family Business !

Thank you for understanding and again sorry for what happened !

- Don

notes.title: Big Update incoming !
notes.notes:
Hello mobsters !

I know it's been a while since we've had a major update, but it's one for good reason!
Family Business is undergoing a " renovation " heavy on codes and mechanics, however the main factor in this update delay is due to a new map coming to Family Business the long awaited Bocotown !
But that's not all, we also have great news! Family Business will be getting its first full weapon animation ! Yes that's right, let's have a weapon with its full animation. It seems little but animations are expensive and so we carefully and carefully select the weapons that will be used for testing. We start with " The Gunfather " the most iconic weapon will receive its animations from shooting and reload to [u ]weapon inspection ! The weapon will still receive a bonus but you will see this at the time of the update!

Other corrections are also being worked on, for example not being able to enter servers without a password , thus mandatory to use them.

We've received some map and mechanic ideas so we're fighting against time to get them to you as quickly as possible.

Another notable change is the textures of mobsters and police aiming for a more striking and balanced gameplay.

We are always trying to improve Family Business with the help of our community! This is just a warning and not all the changes that are being made or even that have already been made, but I think it's fair to communicate the delay of frequent updates! But I promise to make up for it with a new map still in February for Voodoo Business !

Have a good game !

- Don

notes.title: Small update on Hud
notes.notes:
Hello mobsters !

This small update brings some bug fixes but mainly a new HUD to join servers and more match options !

Below is the list of fixes and improvements :


 New Hud in server list
 Added private servers
 LAN addition
 Added new tips and comments
 Improved HUD positioning
 Fixed some weapons having their names wrong
 Fixed "Restore" button not correctly restoring purchases


I know it seems like a small thing, but it's a big step forward because many of our updates are visualizing the future of Family Business with community workshops. I know that many people may be confused by changing versions so quickly but it is a way of guaranteeing our quality.

Recently I know that many must be strange sometimes losing all progress, the reason for this is that the save files are reset when there is an update in the weapons codes, because with a new balance it could cause some instabilities in servers, but I guarantee that already we are working on a solution to this problem and I can even talk about this solution, that involves the Steam Inventory System, since information and purchases made in the game can be stored permanently, but until then we will work using the Steam Cloud functionality (not yet implemented ) . I'm sorry if you missed a lot of progress, but for now in " Early Access " it's difficult to guarantee that there won't be such sudden changes.

I know there were few changes but our focus is to improve the code more and more, thus making our work speed increase a lot. The update was aimed at Huds, however this is just a measure to go on to the next challenge, walk or whatever you prefer that will be the addition of new maps, this takes time and a lot of resources so we are trying to update and fix as many bugs as possible in this right now because the more maps and modes we add the more fixes and bugs will be coming, so to minimize instabilities these are our decisions in updates.

Thank you all and we will continue to update Family Business as soon as possible ! In our next big update will be a map called " Bocotown " which will be for Family Business mode !

Have a good game !

- Don

Now talking a little about the upcoming updates for Family Business !

We are working as much as possible to improve the Huds so that we can add new maps and on top of that our map release logic will always be 1-1 , 1 for Family Business and 1 for Voodoo Business , thus alternating with each release, for example this one month another map should be released for Family Business, and next month one should be released for Voodoo Business. There are still many things to be done and especially to be improved, so please don't forget to do a Family Business review as it helps us a lot and if you want to help even more always comment below the updates because we always look at the comments below as soon as possible possible and obviously also helps us a lot !

We have a fruitful future for Family Business !

Thank you all and good game !

- Don

notes.notes:
Hello mobsters ! How are you doing ? Hope you are all right !
Today is a very special day because Family Business is now in version 0.0.0.4 and above all our first big update of 2023! But let's get to the point, what improved?

I think a good place to start is by showing a fix that has been bothering some detail hunters! The hand on the gun "The Gunfather" was a little wrong and we already fixed it in this update, the comparison is below:
 
OLD

NEW

Taking advantage of this line of adjustments and quality, we also improved the ammo tables from simply a common wooden table to something more specific and not only that but also a variation for the Mafia and another for the Police ! We cherish the logic that the mobsters were criminals and would not have access to great things, the police is different. Below is the comparison :

And to close with a golden key in improvements... finally we have a good "MedKit" ! Below is the photo:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312675/70c6323e1b95278ad2f53a21c0192dfc992df1f5.png
Isn't she cute?!

Ahhh how good the smell of new things is! But if there's one thing better than new, it's improvements and bug fixes! Below are our bug fixes and other improvements:


 Fixed gameover cameras on zombies not switching correctly
 New newsfeed
 Added more objects by map " Kobralyn "
 Weapon balancing
 Audio tweak, improving some songs were not fading during gameplay
 Improved audio in general
 Fix stretched HUDS in store
 Fixed Perks description not showing up in the shop

 Code optimization

In general mobsters these were the main changes! Of course there are some others but they are more detailed or I don't remember (Besides I'm just one) but anyway I believe it should improve a lot in gameplay. I would like to point something out with you who are complaining about there being no servers... Remember Family Business still has some limitations and certainly the biggest one being the " Region Limitation " problem as this prevents some countries from being able to play together and since Family Business sales are all over the world it's a bit complicated...however I promise to solve this problem at some point ! But don't be discouraged, there are always BOTS to console our hearts...

Another important thing to mention is that in the new newsfeed (which is what I wanted to talk to you about) there is a big news: You can announce your idea or project in the Family Business newsfeed! Just get in touch and we'll talk.

Mobsters any bug , problem or suggestion please contact us or even report below this update so we stay aware of everything that happens with Family Business !

I wish you all a great game and let's go for more updates to come! I hope you like the new version and don't forget to review the game, it helps us a lot !

- Don

notes.title: An irrecusable update !
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312675/8081703a3fd6e784de57b868589414ec737f1ecc.png


Our first major update for Family Business:

- Bug fixes
- Improved code optimization for developers
- Fixed not having Game Over on zombies
- Fix for being able to select a character in zombies
- Fixed being able to show the score on zombies
- Map improvement in zombies
- Adjustments in Nav Mesh (Place where the AI ​​can go)
- Weapon balancing (Damage and Recoil)
- Adjustment of values ​​in store items

I know that for many it seems little, but remember that Family Business is only done by one person! Some may even find it strange that I often speak in the plural , but the reason for that is simple , everyone who likes Family Business is part of the game 's production , because without the Family Business community it is nothing , that 's why we always ask you to send us an email talking about bugs , ideas , tips , whatever we want to hear what you have to say about Family Business !

A peek into the future that's coming for Family Business in the year 2023:

- WEAPONS RELOADING ANIMATION (Nobody deserves not to have animation)
- Multiplayer on zombies
- Small campaigns/missions in single player
- Customization of both character and weapons
- New maps for both classic Family Business mode and zombies
- New gamemodes ( Free For All , Capture the Flag , Kill Confirmed , Gun Game , ETC )

And so many other news are yet to come , but with this little peek into the future , you can already imagine what is to come for this project !

I thank everyone who is part of my story! I've always wanted to make games and now it's becoming a reality so I'll never give up working regardless of the results I get! Dream , Believe and Realize !

Thank you for understanding and good game everyone!

- Don
